name: 7plus
description: Browse 7plus catch-up shows and play clear HLS episodes in Jellyfin.
overview: Australian catch-up TV from 7plus. DRM-protected episodes are labelled and cannot be played by this plugin.

versions.changelog: Fix Linux root-relative catalogue links. No provider key is embedded; optional application credentials can be configured locally. Includes market 26 regression checks and cross-platform CI.

Add a dashboard Check and refresh catalogue action that tests live server navigation, shows errors, and refreshes only the 7plus cache after success. Log browse counts and exceptions before Jellyfin can hide them behind empty folders.

Display seasons without waiting for authenticated playback probes. Preserve known DRM labels and identify unknown protection in episode details. Embed the supplied dashboard logo directly and package a fresh plugin image with explicit assembly metadata.
Keep public catalogue and market requests independent of saved account tokens; use the paired account only for playback metadata so sign-in state cannot filter browse results.

Refreshes empty Jellyfin channel caches, loads public 7plus component shelves without account-token filtering, reports unexpected empty shelf responses, and cache-busts the updated 7+ logo while preserving Jellyfin's image resource convention.
